offence_note: Four counts of careless storage of firearms
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the sentence appeal is allowed by varying the appellant’s incarceration to time served and reducing the duration of his prohibition order from five to two years.
note: Weapons prohibition reduced to two years; 12 months jail varied to time served.

offence_note: Break and enter of dwelling at night and theft
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal by reducing the sentence from two years to two years less one day.
note: Probation condition allows residential treatment if directed by probation officer.

sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to a period of incarceration of six months.
note: Victim surcharge waived; s.161 order ten years; mitigating factors only partly shown.

offence_note: Arson of own dwelling endangering neighbours; endangering dog
sentence_quote: The conviction on count two stands, as does the sentence imposed on count two (12 months in jail, two years’ probation, and various ancillary orders).
note: Count one acquitted, count four new trial; only count two sentence stands.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, unprovoked punch in group attack
sentence_quote: I hereby order Mr. Sutton to serve 90 days in a provincial correctional center to be served on an intermittent basis pursuant to section 732(1) of the Code.

offence_note: Criminal contempt by lawyer misleading court on custody credit
note: Contempt conviction and fine quashed; acquittal entered.

sentence_quote: I sentence this man to 18 months in custody. It is to be consecutive to any sentence that he is now serving.
note: Sentence consecutive to sentence being served; UK custody time not credited.

offence_note: Two counts of sexual assault of niece, breach of trust
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, and I would increase the sentence on Count 2 to five and a half years' imprisonment to run concurrently with the sentence on Count 1.
note: Count 1 three and a half years; Count 2 raised to 5.5 years concurrent; ancillary orders unspecified.

offence_note: Possession of marijuana for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I would be inclined in this case to allow the sentence appeal to the extent that I would substitute for the sentence of incarceration of 15 months imposed by the sentencing judge a term of imprisonment of 9 months.
note: Trial judge gave 3 months credit for 35 days custody; 15 months was after credit.
